thread.title: Former Mango Health CEO Joins Apple -- CNBC

author: morningstar.com
title: Former Mango Health CEO Joins Apple -- CNBC
text:
-- Jason Oberfest, the co-founder and former chief executive of Mango Health, has joined Apple Inc. (AAPL), CNBC reported Friday.
-- According to the report, Apple declined to comment on Mr. Oberfest's hiring. A person familiar with his role said Mr. Oberfest will work on medication adherence efforts, the report said. The Mango Health app provides reminders of medication times.
-- In November, Mango Health said Yadin Shemmer would be CEO and said Mr. Oberfest would be a special adviser.
Full story at https://www.cnbc.com/2018/12/07/apple-hires-mango-health-ceojason-oberfest.html
